bibl.title: Epos and Paideia between Orality and Writing.
bibl.seg: Lucio Del Corso, Epos and Paideia between Orality and Writing.

Andrea Ercolani & Laura Lulli (edd.), Rethinking Orality I. Codification, Transcodification and Transmission of "Cultural Messages" = Transcodification: Arts, Languages and Media. 1 (Berlin - Boston, 2022) pp. 119-145, figg.
bibl.note: Using among others extant ostraka and papyri, offers a quick overview of the role played by epic poetry in the Greek educative system and of the evolution of the corpus of texts used by teachers and students.
